MitigationInstructions: 1. Find the timestamp when the availability dropped.
2. Use the Kusto Query provided in the Incident discussion entries to check the current availability.
2a) Use the cluster name wawscus and database name wawsprod for any queries with the function 'All'
2b) For all the other queries extract the cluster name info from the incident discussion entries.
3. If recovered, then mark the incident as Mitigated with the summary of your findings.
4. If not recovered, then post the details of your findings in the ICM incident and transfer the incident for Human Intervention.
